lines.zh: 走过下界岩，热我都不觉得
lines.en: I cross netherrack and don't feel the heat.

lines.zh: 我的名字在别人嘴里会乱码
lines.en: My name garbles in other mouths.
Flecks of gold light still hang on me.
I drift a little with each step.
My bones show more clearly than my hide.
I pass along the lava's edge.
I head toward the living.
Something on me rings like iron.
I remember how I died.
I can't call out; I can only walk.
Every road I take is one I've walked before.

lines.zh: 我站着，风从我身上穿过去
lines.en: I stand and the wind passes through me.
My face is glitched, hard to read.
I still clutch a piece of gold.
I'm listening to the lava flow.

lines.zh: 别人给我的名字会坏掉
lines.en: The name others gave me keeps breaking.
I can't quite remember the order.
Light leaks between my bones.
This place is colder than I remember.
My chest doesn't rise.

lines.zh: 我在数自己还剩几根骨头
lines.en: I'm counting how many bones I have left.

lines.zh: 你看见我，说明我还在这里
lines.en: You can see me, so I'm still here.
Don't say my name.
There's someone behind you too.
I'm not a living piglin.
Your gold is ringing.
I don't take your things anymore.

lines.zh: 我数着你胸口起伏，一二。
lines.en: I count your breaths: one, two.
Are you shaking from the cold?
Can you make out this face?
Something stands between us.

lines.zh: 你的灵魂味道，混着金子。
lines.en: Your soul smells of gold and fear.
Say something; I'll remember it.

lines.zh: 你脚下很实，我脚下是空的
lines.en: Your feet are solid; mine aren't.

lines.zh: 我的魂被砸得散了一线。
lines.en: The hit scatters a thread of my soul.

lines.zh: 这一下打在过去的位置
lines.en: That hit where I used to be.
I feel no pain.
I've grown fainter.
I retreat, very lightly.
I'm still here.
The hole closed quickly.
I can't remember just now.
Don't hit twice.
Gold; I still want it.
That piece in your hand, stop waving it.
I won't grab; I'll only look.
Give it and I couldn't hold it.

lines.zh: 我的名字变成了一串乱码。
lines.en: My name has become a string of garbage.
Gold is better in living hands.
Put it away.
Just looking is enough.
Who's that one for?

lines.zh: 我碰不到你，你也碰不到我
lines.en: I can't touch you, nor you me.
We met, and there was only wind.
You stepped back.

lines.zh: 这一下，我的形状散了一点
lines.en: That scattered my shape a little.
Don't try your sword on me.
I'm cold; keep some distance.
You're standing in my old prints.
Move, I'm drifting.
I take no space.
That has nothing to do with me now.
I can't even keep myself.
There are other souls in the Nether.
We don't pair; we drift.
I can't say a name.
I can't answer that.
There's nothing between us.
I can't recall what came before.
Don't say that name.
I have to go.
The hand I reach out with is empty.
The gold stays on the ground.
I want to pick it up and can't.
I nudged it with my foot.
I remember this.
Alive, I would have grabbed it.
Not anymore.
It rolled to the lava's edge.
Take it if you want it.
I don't need it.
Something living over there.
I go toward the warmth.
I see light.
There's breathing.
I remember this direction.
I drift over slowly.
Watching it from here is enough.
Past the fire, a few blocks.

lines.zh: 我看见火里有东西在走
lines.en: I see something walking in the fire.

lines.zh: 这个方向有活人的气味
lines.en: There's living scent this way.
It's standing where I once stood.

lines.zh: 我认得这条路，它通向上面
lines.en: I know this road; it leads up.
However fast you go, I keep up.
My feet make no sound.
I'm very close.

lines.zh: 我的影子没有，你怎么找我
lines.en: I have no shadow; how will you find me?
You stopped by the stone.
I drift half a block nearer.
It turned.
The last stretch.
I drift behind your shoulder, easy.

lines.zh: 我绕到它前面，它看不见
lines.en: I circle in front of it unseen.
I've stayed within three steps of it.
I reach out and there's nothing.
Wind passed over you.

lines.zh: 我的手从你肩里穿过去
lines.en: My hand passed through your shoulder.
This is all I can do.
My gold spilled everywhere.

lines.zh: 你听见有人叫你名字吗
lines.en: Did you hear your name called?
My name is only garbled text now.
This isn't an attack.
I only wanted to come close.

lines.zh: 我把手放在它肩上，它没感觉
lines.en: I lay a hand on its shoulder; it feels nothing.
It heard something and turned.
I've stood behind it a long while.
This time I'm closer.
I come out of the lava's smoke.

lines.zh: 灵魂形状的猪灵站在这里
lines.en: A piglin in soul shape stands here.

lines.zh: 我身上还带着过去的金
lines.en: I still carry the gold of my past.
Nether light falls on me.
My name glitched another square.
Let me see where I am.
No shadow at my feet.
Did anyone hear me?
I rise out of the firelight.

lines.zh: 这片石头比我的记忆新
lines.en: These stones are newer than my memory.
I drift above where I used to stand.
The light in my bones hasn't gone out.
I head toward the sound.
Fire is familiar to me; it doesn't burn.

lines.zh: 我落下去，但没有落到底
lines.en: I fell, and didn't land.
I'm very light in water.

lines.zh: 炸开的时候，我被吹淡了
lines.en: The blast thinned me out.
The arrow passed through without stopping.
The spell hit and I flickered bright.
I don't eat; only bones remain.

lines.zh: 雷打来，我整具骨架都亮了
lines.en: Lightning struck and my whole frame lit.
The void is much like me.
